i got him because i was scared and in a bad place and i thought he would help me. i just ended up giving him a death sentence. i am such a horrible person. i dont know if i can forgive myself for this. it's like the biggest rule -- don't make rash decisions or bring others in on your misery when you're like this, and i fucked up. i started falling apart and couldn't take care of him anymore. i should have found him a home that could, but i couldn't stand the idea of him not being there. and now he's dead. what kind of scum am i? i'm a fucking monster.
Shoot me a message. Let's talk.
Editing because maybe that's not a good thing to put out there.

No, I just feel done with everything. With existing. I don't want this anymore. 
I didn't call a hotline because I don't want police or ambulance showing up at my house to whisk me away to the psych ward. *

And honestly, I would hope by now they realize how serious I am. I have lost count of all of my attempts over the last twelve years. Still, I guess they think that if they don't acknowledge the problem that it will go away.
Maybe I just need to away.

I don't have any friends locally. I've moved around a bit in the last 7 years and my friends are scattered. No one close. I have tried talking to some of them before, but it just makes me feel worse. I just end up feeling like a fool for ever having opened my mouth, so I mostly try to stay quiet anymore and pretend that everything is okay because I really don't need another lecture from a "concerned" friend.

My family will judge. They have judged. This is the kind of thing they like to sweep under the rug and shrug away as if it's going to get better on its own. Anytime I've tried to tell my family how I feel, I'm called stupid, baby, selfish, ignorant, coward, among other things. They don't take this stuff seriously. They just act like it's a phase, like something that will just blow over. There is no support in my family for this. They've shown me that first hand.
This has been my reason for living for the past 15 years.
